comment: Variation on petattr-first-pick-redraws-pet: hilite_pet in the rc gives the Caveman's little dog inverse video (optfn_boolean, options.c:5300-5308), then the first live option change sets petattr to none through handler_petattr(), which clears iflags.hilite_pet and asks for the repaint (6152-6162), so the dog is drawn plain at once. Seed, clock, character and keys chosen for this case.
